The rate that actually applies is the one displayed on the product page. After the promotion ends, the fixed boost no longer applies, and the product rate will adjust in real time based on market conditions.
## How to participate
Make your net deposit: meet the net deposit requirement for the corresponding coin within the net deposit calculation period.
Subscribe to the product: go to Simple Earn and subscribe to the promotional product for the corresponding coin and threshold.
Earn the boost: eligibility is determined automatically. Once your eligibility is updated, the boost applies up to the corresponding cap - no additional registration is required.
Website: Navigation bar >
Earn >
Simple Earn. Search for the coin and select the corresponding promotional product.
App: Home >
Join the Bitget Super Earn Festival and get even more from your Earn returns!
## Notes
## 1. Participation details
By participating in the promotion, you are deemed to have read and agreed to the
Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
- Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
- The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.
## 5. Rule changes and violations

- Data, limits, APRs and reward estimates displayed on the promotion page are for reference only. The final basis is Bitget's backend settlement records and the relevant promotion announcements. If the promotion cannot proceed normally due to system issues, market conditions, liquidity, regulatory requirements, force majeure or other reasonable causes, Bitget reserves the right to adjust the promotion rules, limits, APR, eligibility and promotion period.

If fraud, the use of multiple accounts to claim rewards, or participation through electronic, bot, duplicate or automated means is detected, Bitget reserves the right to disqualify the participant and revoke their rewards, and promotion rewards on the relevant accounts will be voided.
- This promotion is open only to users who meet Bitget's eligibility requirements and whose participation is not restricted by applicable laws, regulatory requirements, regional restrictions, or Bitget's internal policies. Users in restricted regions, users with restricted accounts, and any other users who do not meet Bitget's eligibility requirements may not register for or participate in this promotion, or receive or claim any promotion rewards. Users are responsible for confirming that their participation does not violate the laws and regulations that apply in their location. Bitget may adjust eligibility for this promotion based on legal, regulatory, or risk control requirements. Eligibility, eligible trading volume, and rewards are determined in accordance with these promotion rules and Bitget's final backend settlement records. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Bitget may adjust, suspend, or cancel this promotion due to legal or regulatory requirements, risk control, market changes, system maintenance, force majeure, or other reasonable and necessary causes.
- By participating in this promotion, you are deemed to have read, understood, and agreed to the Bitget User Agreement, Privacy Policy, applicable product terms, risk disclosures, and these promotion rules. Bitget reserves the right to revise the promotion terms or cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice, and retains the final right of interpretation of these terms. If you have any questions, please contact our customer service team.

Venue: Bitget
Headline: IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit is now live: up to 10% APR for 15 days on USDT and USDGO

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To help everyone taking part in IPO Prime put their capital to work more efficiently and get more out of the promotion, Bitget is launching the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit. Once the Anthropic IPO allocation is settled, your unallocated funds are automatically moved into the exclusive Simple Earn Flexible product for the asset you committed, earning a boosted APR of up to 10% for 15 days (see the table below for exact rates). Interest is paid out every hour, and you can redeem at any time.
1. Promotion details
During the promotion period, users who subscribe to IPO Prime with a supported asset and keep the "IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit' enabled will, after allocation settlement, have their unallocated funds moved first into the IPO Prime exclusive Simple Earn Flexible product and earn the exclusive 15-day APR.The benefit applies to both the VIP round and the public round, with exclusive quota available on a first-come, first-served basis:
IPO Prime exclusive Simple Earn
Asset | Product | Exclusive APR | Exclusive APR period | Supported subscription asset
USDT | Exclusive Simple Earn Flexible | 10% | 15 days | USDT
USDGO | Exclusive Simple Earn Flexible | 10% | 15 days | USDGO
*The exclusive product exists only to hold unallocated IPO Prime funds. It cannot be subscribed to directly from the Earn page or through the API.
*If the exclusive product's quota is insufficient, funds are moved into another Simple Earn Flexible product you're currently eligible to subscribe to and earn interest at the applicable tiered rate.
*Unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round both go into the exclusive product for the same asset and share that asset's exclusive APR.
*Product parameters are subject to what's displayed on the product page.Once the exclusive APR period ends, the product rate is adjusted in real time based on market conditions.
2. How to enable or disable "IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit"
## Set it when you subscribe:
Website: IPO Prime > Anthropic > Subscribe > check the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit at the bottom of the subscription pop-up.
App: Home > IPO Prime entry > Anthropic > Subscribe > check the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit at the bottom of the subscription pop-up.
Exact entry names and locations are subject to what's displayed on the actual product page.
The feature is enabled by default, and you can disable it at any time. If you disable it, your unallocated funds are returned to your spot/funding account.Whether the benefit is enabled has no effect on your IPO subscription eligibility, allocation priority, or allocated amount.
3. Exclusive quota queueing and modification rules
1. Queueing rules: exclusive quota is allocated in order of the first subscription time corresponding to each queued amount, with the VIP round and the public round calculating allocations and unallocated funds separately.Unallocated funds from the VIP round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the VIP round, and unallocated funds from the public round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the public round.A single user's unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round each form one separate queue entry. If the same asset is subscribed to more than once within a round, the unallocated funds for that round are combined into a single entry.
2. Modifying after subscribing: the subscription pop-ups for both the VIP round and the public round let you enable/disable this feature, and you can change the setting up until the public round's subscription end time. This setting applies to all your unallocated funds in both the VIP round and the public round. Changing the setting during the public round also changes how your VIP round unallocated funds are handled. Enabling, disabling, or enabling it back does not change your position in the exclusive quota queue. Queueing is always based on your first subscription time in each round.The system applies the last setting you confirmed before the deadline.
4. How to view your details after allocation settlement
Allocation results: IPO Prime > Anthropic > View allocation results.VIP round and public round results are shown separately, so you can check your subscription quantity, committed amount, allocated amount, unallocated funds, and whether the exclusive Earn benefit is enabled for each asset.
Earn holdings (website): Navigation bar > Earn > Account overview > Simple Earn Flexible.
Earn holdings (app): Home > Earn overview > Simple Earn > Holdings details.
Notes
## IPO Prime exclusive Simple Earn & Simple Earn:
1. Eligibility: main accounts that have completed identity verification and take part in this IPO Prime round with USDT or USDGO (sub-accounts excluded).
2. By enabling this benefit, you're deemed to have read and agreed to Bitget's Simple Earn Product Agreement, and to have authorized Bitget to use your unallocated funds to automatically subscribe to the corresponding Simple Earn product after allocation settlement.
3. Interest accrual: once funds are moved in, accrual begins at the next full hour after the subscription succeeds, and interest is paid out hourly starting one hour after accrual begins.
4. Interest calculation: hourly interest = accrual amount × that hour's APR ÷ 365 ÷ 24.
5. This benefit applies only to unallocated funds from this IPO Prime round. The specific amount of unallocated funds, the product they're moved into, and the timing of the transfer are subject to Bitget's backend settlement records.
Promotion quota is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The limited-time Bitget Stock PoolX promotion is now live! During the promotion, eligible users can stake designated U.S. stock rTokens for a chance to share 50,000 USDT in rewards. Stake three popular U.S. stock assets—NVIDIA (rNVDA), Nasdaq 100 (rQQQ), and S&P 500 (rSPY)—to earn additional rewards.
## Promotion period: November 17, 2026, 19:00 UTC+8 – December 01, 2026, 19:00 UTC+8
Stake now
U.S. stock staking pool details
Asset to stake | Total USDT rewards | Staking cap

rQQQ (Nasdaq 100) | 10,000 USDT | 4,500 rQQQ
rSPY (S&P 500) | 10,000 USDT | 4,000 rSPY
## Eligibility
This promotion features three PoolX staking pools: the rNVDA New User Pool, rQQQ Pool, and rSPY Pool. The rNVDA New User Pool is exclusively available to users who register with Bitget on or after November 1, 2026, at 00:00 (UTC+8).
All participants must complete identity verification and meet the promotion requirements.
## Reward distribution rules
During the promotion, eligible new users can participate in the corresponding reward pool by staking the designated rToken. Each user's share of the USDT rewards will be based on their proportion of the total valid staked amount.
## Reward calculation formula
User's USDT reward = User's valid staked amount ÷ Total valid staked amount of all eligible users in the corresponding staking pool × USDT reward amount for the corresponding staking pool
Rewards for the rNVDA, rQQQ, and rSPY staking pools are calculated separately.
Users must stake the corresponding rToken to qualify for reward distribution from that pool.
The total rewards for each staking pool are fixed, while actual returns will vary dynamically based on participants' valid staked amounts.
For specific staking requirements, the reward calculation period, calculation methods, and final reward distribution results, refer to the promotion page.
## Terms and conditions
Participants must complete identity verification to be eligible for rewards.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions.
Sub-accounts, institutional users, and market makers are not eligible to participate in the promotion.
Each staking pool has a staking limit. Refer to the promotion page for the specific staking cap and remaining capacity.
If any fraudulent or illegal activity, including using multiple accounts to claim the airdrop, or any other violation is detected, Bitget reserves the right to disqualify the users involved and revoke their rewards.
Bitget reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to change or revise the promotion terms or cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice.
Bitget reserves the right of final interpretation of this promotion. If you have any questions, please contact our customer service team.
After the promotion ends, staked assets will be unlocked according to the applicable PoolX rules. Refer to the promotion page for the specific unlock time, reward distribution method, and crediting time.
Stock tokens and related digital assets are subject to market and price volatility risks. Users are advised to fully understand the relevant products and promotion rules, conduct their own research, and assume the associated investment risks.
